title: Senior Accountant
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Accountant
**TOP 3 SKILLS:** Technical Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Multi Entity Accounting
LOCATION: Sacramento, CA
DURATION:
RATE RANGE:

POSITION SUMMARY:
Under general supervision of the CFO, the Senior Accountant is responsible for serving as the liaison between company Staff and Accounting on three key areas: general ledger/financial reporting, revenue, receivables, deferred revenue, and intercompany accounting. The Senior Accountant plays a critical role on the finance and accounting team by managing aspects of the day-to-day accounting activities primarily on the revenue and AR side, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and maintaining compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements. They will partner with the internal teams and external accounting partner to contribute to general ledger activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, and account analysis. Working closely with internal departments and the organization's external accounting partner, the Senior Accountant contributes to general ledger activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, account analysis, and month-end close processes.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
AR, Revenue, & Deferred Revenue

  • Review customer agreements and non ‐ standard billing arrangements to ensure accurate billing and revenue recognition.
  • Reconcile membership dues to revenue system reports, cash receipts, deferred revenue, general ledger activity, and prepare related journal entries.

General Ledger, Close & Financial Reporting
  • Prepare complex journal entries and supporting schedules in accordance with GAAP.
  • Support monthly close activities by providing accurate schedules, analysis, and documentation.
  • Research and resolve account reconciliation variances and discrepancies independently.
  • Assist in the preparation of financial statements and management reports.

Intercompany Accounting
  • Accounting for assigned grants, including revenue, deferred revenue for our charitable arm, a Foundation.
  • Reconcile intercompany accounts monthly

Audit, Budget, Compliance Support
  • Respond to requests in support of annual audits and tax filings and budget preparation for two separate entities.

Process Improvement & Team Support
  • Assist with documenting and improving accounting processes and internal controls.
  • Provide backup support for accounting operations, including banking, accounts payable, and accounts receivable functions.
  • Mentor and support entry level Accounting Staff
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:
  • BS in Accounting, finance or related field, preferred with 3-5 years relevant progressive experience
  • Working knowledge of GAAP, general accounting procedures, financial reporting (must understand difference between balance sheet and P&L accounts), and internal controls
  • Carry out the proper procedures to ensure internal controls are met
  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and analytical skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, QuickBooks, or other accounting software or ERP systems
  • Intermediate level working knowledge of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, linked workbooks, etc.)
  • Proven ability to take initiative, anticipate challenges, develop solutions, exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Proven initiative for working independently
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of company and client information
  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines under minimal supervision

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
  • Working with fund accounting
  • Expense reporting platforms like Bill.com, Concur, and Ramp
  • Reading financial reporting trends and providing guidance to those not familiar

title: MLOps/ML Platform Engineer
description:
JOB TITLE: ML Ops/ML Platform Engineer
LOCATION: Remote
DURATION: FTE
RATE RANGE: $150,000-$200,000

POSITION SUMMARY:

Our client is a leading football intelligence technology company that specializes in providing an innovative suite of products for football fans and NFL clubs. They are a collection of executives, engineers, data scientists, and visionaries from NFL clubs, technology startups, finance, and academia.
Their data-driven platform empowers teams with insights and tools to make informed decisions within salary cap constraints. The platform also serves the NCAA, offering insights around the transfer portal and more.
What sets them apart is their unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Their domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

As an MLOps/ML Platform Engineer, you’ll build and operate the core systems that power their machine learning and AI workloads across sports domains. You’ll own the infrastructure that keeps their models fast, reliable, and cost-efficient — from data ingestion and training to model serving, deployment, and observability.
This is a hands-on engineering role that blends software infrastructure, distributed systems, and machine learning productionization. You’ll work closely with the Deep Learning Research, LLMOps, and Product Engineering teams to ensure that every model we build can be trained, deployed, and monitored at scale.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and operate ML infrastructure: Manage data, training, serving, and inference systems for high-throughput model workflows.
  • Build scalable pipelines: Implement reproducible training and evaluation pipelines with versioning, scheduling, and artifact tracking.
  • Optimize compute and cost: Tune GPU and CPU workloads, manage clusters, and drive efficiency via rightsizing, spot scheduling, and caching.
  • Serve models in production: Operate APIs for low-latency inference with autoscaling, blue-green or canary rollouts, and rollback safety.
  • Ensure reliability and observability: Define and own SLOs; instrument pipelines and services to track latency, cost, drift, and data quality.
  • Secure and automate: Manage IAM, secrets, and container security; automate deployment pipelines via CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with research scientists and AI engineers to deliver models from experiment to production with minimal friction.
  • Document and enable: Build templates, runbooks, and internal tooling that make ML workflows repeatable, safe, and fast.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years of experience in ML platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD, containers, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience managing GPU clusters and training/inference pipelines.
  • Familiarity with data orchestration and storage formats (Delta, Parquet, Polars, Spark).
  • Proven ability to ship and operate production ML systems with SLOs.
  • Strong Python skills and comfort with infrastructure as code and automation.
  • Experience with observability and cost optimization at scale.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with real-time or low-latency model serving (REST, gRPC).
  • Exposure to model registry and promotion workflows.
  • Familiarity with data quality, lineage, and curation pipelines.
  • Background in sports analytics or other high-volume data domains.
  • Experience integrating LLM workflows or evaluation pipelines.


Benefits:

  • Competitive Salary and Bonus Plan
  • Comprehensive health insurance plan
  • Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match
  • Remote working environment
  • A flexible, unlimited time off policy
  • Generous paid holiday schedule - 13 in total including Monday after the Super Bowl

  • Experience with APQP, PPAP, Supplier Assessments, Product Launches, and Vendor Ramp activities.
  • Experience with Injection Molding, Stamping, Electromechanical Assemblies, GD&T, ISO 9000, and IATF 16949.

Overview:
The Supplier Quality Engineer will play a key role in ensuring world-class performance of the prototype and production supply base, and in driving continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be entrepreneurial, driven, energetic, detailed, and team-oriented. Candidates with experience in Automotive, Interior and Exterior components/subassemblies such as Seating Systems, A-Class Surface Parts with gloss and color requirements, and a strong understanding of manufacturing processes such as Injection & Blow Molding and Sheet Metal Forming are highly preferred.

Responsibilities:
  • Works with Vehicle Systems Engineering to assess the manufacturability of new product designs.
  • Works with Engineering and Strategic Sourcing Managers to select appropriate suppliers with the right manufacturing know-how by conducting detailed supplier process assessments/audits and providing feedback to management on final selection.
  • Works with suppliers on all technical design elements of the drawing. Conducts CAD model and print reviews with suppliers to assess design for manufacturability and collaborates in investigating/developing new manufacturing techniques (if necessary) to meet design requirements.
  • Leads the Supplier Industrialization Roadmap (SIR) by conducting product and process development activities and capability assessments at supplier manufacturing sites.
  • Identifies supplier CapEx production equipment, tooling, and fixturing requirements in line with project implementation timelines and drives all qualification activities to verify and validate tooling and fixturing.
  • Works with Strategic Sourcing Managers to assess supplier readiness for different vehicle build events, identifies and highlights risks related to production ramp, and collaborates on risk mitigation plans while reporting updates to management.
  • Responsible for managing and continuously improving the APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) process with suppliers from the initial design stage through PPAP submission and all the way through SOP (Start of Production).
  • Responsible for training and setting up suppliers in the Supplier Quality Portal, reviewing prototype and production parts quality document submissions, and providing feedback as required.
  • Leads RCCA analysis with suppliers, issues corrective actions, supports immediate containment, short-term and long-term corrective actions, and ensures supplier process documentation is updated with manufacturing process changes.
  • Provides support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Vehicle Engineering regarding analysis and disposition of suspect supplier material. Participates in MRB (Material Review Board) disposition meetings as required.
  • Responsible for analyzing and reporting incoming supplier part quality metrics for the assigned supply base, including First Article Inspection Reports, Cp/Cpk analysis, Pareto analysis, Statistical Process Control, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Drives continuous improvement throughout the supply base using quality and lean manufacturing tools.
  • Improves supplier quality processes such as assessments, supplier management, and part approval processes.
  • Up to 40% domestic/international travel required, occasionally on short notice.

Qualifications:
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent engineering degree.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Quality, Supplier Quality, or Manufacturing within the automotive, aviation, or medical device industries, or a combination of Supplier Quality and Internal Plant Quality Development.
  • Experience in New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Experience creating and improving quality systems.
  • Experience using problem-solving techniques such as Six Sigma, 8D, Pareto Charts, Regression Analysis, ANOVA, DOE, Fishbone Analysis, and Red-X.
  • Experience with core process control tools such as Process Flow Diagrams, Process FMEAs, Process Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and Process Capability.
  • Experience with manufacturing processes such as Injection Molding, Stamping, and Electromechanical Assemblies.
  • Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T), Tooling and Fixture Verification & Validation, and final buyoff at supplier facilities.
  • Working knowledge of Quality and Automotive Systems such as ISO 9000 and IATF 16949.
  • Certifications such as CQE (ASQ), Six Sigma Green Belt, or Certified Quality Systems Auditor are highly preferred.
  • Solid knowledge of conducting Supplier Assessments, APQP and PPAP, Product Launches, and Vendor Ramp activities.
  • Fully proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Company:
Our client is a global leader in creative software, offering innovative tools for digital media creation, design, and marketing.

About the Role:
The Voice of Customer (VOC) program for C&P Enterprise captures, organizes, and activates customer feedback to drive product decisions across core solutions. At the center of this program is Enterpret, a new third-party platform that enables field teams, product managers, and executives to collect, analyze, and act on customer insights at scale. The VOC Platform Success Specialist ensures that VOC platform users and stakeholders are supported, engaged, and realize value. The role serves as the bridge between Enterpret's capabilities and the people who depend on it, translating program strategy into daily execution.

This is a high-impact role during a critical growth phase. VOC is actively launching new use cases and onboarding cross-functional users to Enterpret, while expanding the Strategic Product Feedback Loop and Interlock framework to new solutions. The right person will become the leading functional expert on Enterpret: the go-to resource for how the platform is used, how stakeholders get value from it, and how it connects to VOC workflows, working alongside the platform architect and developer who own the technical build.

We are looking for someone who is part platform expert, part customer success manager, and part analyst. You are proactive, consultative, and energized by helping people unlock the value of new tools. You build relationships that drive adoption, translate data into stories that make VOC impact visible, and bring the operational follow-through that keeps the program moving.

Key Responsibilities:
  • User Onboarding & Enablement
    • Onboard new Enterpret users across field, PMM, Strategy & Operations and Product teams; guide them through platform setup, core workflows, and best practices
    • Develop and maintain enablement resources including FAQs, how-to guides, workflow tips, and onboarding materials that help users get up to speed quickly and independently
    • Track user onboarding progress and adoption; identify gaps and proactively address them
  • Stakeholder Guidance & Support
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for Enterpret users. Not just answering questions but actively advising stakeholders on how to optimize their VOC workflows and get more value from the platform
    • Connect platform capabilities to each stakeholder's specific use cases, data needs, and reporting goals
    • Troubleshoot user issues and escalate platform bugs or technical gaps to the platform architect and developer as needed
  • Proactive Reporting & Insights Distribution
    • Regularly review platform data to identify insights and opportunities that would be meaningful to specific user groups or workstreams
    • Build and distribute targeted reports and insight summaries that surface VOC value to stakeholders and create reasons to engage
    • Use insight delivery as a relationship-building motion by proactively bringing data to stakeholders rather than waiting for requests
  • Program Engagement Analytics Reporting
    • Produce a monthly program engagement report for the VOC Program Lead, combining:
      • Quantitative platform engagement data from Enterpret
      • Feedback submission volume and compliance data from the Program Operations & Governance lead
      • Qualitative input from stakeholders on how they are using VOC data and the impact it is having
    • Maintain a clear, consistent view of program health that supports leadership decision-making and investment conversations
  • Enterpret Taxonomy Management
    • Own the product taxonomy update process within Enterpret: the classification and vocabulary framework that ensures insights are organized and searchable
      • Receive structured update requests from Product teams via the Taxonomy Editor interface
      • Implement approved changes in Enterpret accurately and on a timely basis
      • Maintain a log of all taxonomy updates and communicate changes to relevant stakeholders
  • Interlock Follow-Up Execution
    • Execute high-priority Interlock follow-up workstreams, applying program and platform expertise to advance outstanding actions
    • Serve as the operational resource for stakeholders with questions about the VOC program or platform during follow-up cycles
    • Coordinate with the Program Operations & Governance lead, who owns workflow setup, timing, and communication accountability
  • VOC Platform Feedback Collection & Recommendations
    • Support VOC platform feedback collection processes to ensure field and product teams can contribute effectively
    • Gather user feedback on the platform experience and surface actionable recommendations for improving submission, navigation, and overall usability
  • Program Management Overflow
    • Provide tactical support to the Program Operations & Governance lead on program management execution as bandwidth requires
    • Assist with documentation, status tracking, and stakeholder-facing program materials

The Program Operations & Governance lead owns process governance, timing, and communication accountability across VOC workstreams. This role's contribution is execution, applying program and platform expertise to advance workstreams under their direction.

Required:
  • 3-5 years of experience in customer success, platform enablement, program coordination, or a similar role, ideally in an enterprise software or SaaS environment
  • Strong platform fluency: able to become the leading functional expert on Enterpret, comfortable navigating, configuring, and administering the platform and guiding others on how to use it effectively
  • Analytical fluency: comfortable working with platform data, identifying patterns, and building clear, stakeholder-ready reports and summaries
  • Consultative mindset: moves beyond answering questions to proactively understanding stakeholder needs and connecting them to platform capabilities
  • Relationship builder: able to develop trust with stakeholders across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex platform or program concepts into clear, accessible language
  • Highly organized and self-directed; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with minimal oversight
  • Proactive orientation: identifies opportunities to add value without waiting to be asked

Preferred:
  • Experience as a power user, internal champion, or enablement lead for an enterprise software platform
  • Experience training or enabling others on software tools
  • Familiarity with customer feedback programs, VOC operations, or research workflows
  • Experience working with or supporting product teams in a product-adjacent role
  • Familiarity with products or the digital media/document workflow space

Education:
  • Undergraduate degree or MBA.

About the VOC Program:
  • The Voice of Customer program operates at the intersection of field intelligence and product strategy. Our mission is to make the customer voice a consistent, actionable input into product decisions, and to make the teams who collect and contribute that feedback feel the direct impact of their work.
  • The VOC Platform Success Specialist sits at the foundation of that mission. Enterpret is how the program scales, and how well it scales depends on how well users are supported, engaged, and getting value from it. This role is the human engine behind that.
  • You will work closely with field teams (CSS, TAM, Solution Consulting), product managers across C&P solutions, and VOC team leadership.

description:

LOCATION: Foster City, CA (Hybrid; 3 days in office)

TOP 3 SKILLS:
  • 6+ years of Technical Program Management experience leading complex cross-functional hardware and/or software programs.

  • Strong understanding of AI/LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic coding workflows using tools such as Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Windsurf.​

Job Description:
The Advanced Hardware Engineering (AHE) team is responsible for delivering the compute and controls hardware, infotainment and telematics control units, and electrical components that power the future fleet of self-driving vehicles. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead AHE Operations, including quarterly planning, budgeting, and various other operational improvement initiatives. You will also lead the definition, development, and rollout of AI automation tools that empower AHE TPMs and Engineering to significantly elevate their productivity.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally with engineering teams and partners across hardware, firmware, software, vehicle engineering, procurement, and manufacturing. You will serve as an authentic and passionate servant leader within One. Guided by our core principles, you will help deliver AHE systems end-to-end and enable it to meet its business objectives.

We’d love to hear from you if you enjoy solving challenging problems across diverse cross-functional teams, delivering milestones with complex dependencies, and scaling your impact by developing and adopting structured ways of working. If you’re an expert at herding cats and influencing without formal authority, this role was made for you.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead AHE Operations: Lead the AHE quarterly planning process, budgeting, and various operational improvement initiatives. These initiatives may include developing systematic approaches to JIRA planning and issue management frameworks. Assist in TPM processes and continuous improvement frameworks that increase engineering velocity and system reliability.
  • Lead AHE AI Tools and Scaling: Lead the definition, development, and rollout of AI automation tools that empower AHE TPMs and Engineering to significantly elevate productivity through agentic integration across JIRA, Confluence, Slack, Google Suite, and other IT tools.
  • Drive Issue Resolution: Own AHE’s JIRA hygiene and issue-resolution targets, supporting the team in resolving critical issues and cross-team requests within agreed timelines.
  • Configuration Management: Work with cross-functional teams to streamline firmware configuration for all projects across different target configuration phases.
  • Collaborate: Actively invite diverse perspectives, ensuring all voices are heard and valued in decision-making to strengthen outcomes as One Team.
  • Communicate Status: Develop and maintain standard reports and one-pagers to communicate program status, risks, issues, and achievements concisely and effectively to key stakeholders and leadership.

Qualifications:
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent job experience.
  • At least 6 years of experience in Technical Program Management with a strong track record of leading and delivering complex cross-functional programs across hardware and/or software.
  • Processes and Operations: Hands-on familiarity with end-to-end product development processes, with proficiency in tools required to manage complex programs (i.e., Gantt charts, risk tracking and reporting, Smartsheet, JIRA, etc.).
  • AI: Proven understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI tools such as Claude and Gemini. Proficiency in agentic coding workflows using Cursor, Claude Code, Visual Studio Code, Windsurf, or other Integrated Development Environments.
  • Ability to keep the big picture in focus and provide clear, well-structured, and concise communications tailored to the appropriate audience. Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills are required.

Bonus Qualifications:
  • AI: Proven experience building AI-based solutions in SMB/Enterprise environments to automate workflows across JIRA, Confluence, Google Suite, Slack, and other productivity tools.
  • Operations: Previous product development Operations Program Management experience spanning areas such as budgeting, organization-wide planning cycles, risk management, reporting (JIRA, dashboards), and process development.
